_comment: Job role knowledge base. Skill levels: 1 Beginner, 2 Intermediate, 3 Advanced, 4 Expert. A must_have entry is met when ANY skill in 'skills' reaches 'min_level'. min_years is total professional/internship experience.

roles.title: Python Developer (Entry Level)
roles.description: Write backend services and scripts in Python, build REST APIs with Django, Flask or FastAPI, work with SQL databases and version control.

roles.title: Java Backend Developer (Entry Level)
roles.description: Develop server-side applications in Java using Spring Boot, design REST APIs, and work with relational databases.

roles.title: Software Development Engineer (SDE-1)
roles.description: Solve problems with strong data structures and algorithms, write clean object-oriented code in a mainstream language, and ship features in a product team.

roles.title: Frontend Developer
roles.description: Build responsive user interfaces with HTML, CSS and JavaScript using React, Angular or Vue, and integrate with REST APIs.

roles.title: Full Stack Developer (MERN)
roles.description: Build complete web applications with MongoDB, Express, React and Node.js, from database to user interface.

roles.title: Full Stack Developer (Python)
roles.description: Build web products end to end with a Python backend (Django, Flask or FastAPI) and a modern JavaScript frontend.

roles.title: PHP / Laravel Developer
roles.description: Develop and maintain web applications using PHP and Laravel with MySQL databases.

roles.title: Data Analyst
roles.description: Clean and analyse data with SQL, Excel and Python, build dashboards in Power BI or Tableau, and communicate insights to stakeholders.

roles.title: Business Intelligence (BI) Developer
roles.description: Design data models and interactive dashboards in Power BI or Tableau on top of SQL data warehouses.

roles.title: Data Scientist (Entry Level)
roles.description: Build and evaluate machine learning models in Python using pandas and scikit-learn, perform statistical analysis and exploratory data analysis.

roles.title: Machine Learning Engineer
roles.description: Train, optimise and deploy machine learning models to production using Python, PyTorch or TensorFlow, APIs and containers.

roles.title: Deep Learning / Computer Vision Engineer
roles.description: Build image and video models such as classification and object detection using CNNs, OpenCV and PyTorch or TensorFlow.

roles.title: NLP / GenAI Engineer
roles.description: Build language applications with transformers and large language models: text classification, retrieval augmented generation, prompt engineering and fine-tuning.

roles.title: Data Engineer
roles.description: Build reliable ETL data pipelines with SQL, Python and Spark, orchestrate with Airflow and load into data warehouses.

roles.title: MLOps Engineer
roles.description: Automate the machine learning lifecycle: model versioning, CI/CD for models, containerised serving and monitoring on cloud.

roles.title: DevOps Engineer
roles.description: Automate build and deployment with CI/CD pipelines, Docker and Kubernetes, manage Linux servers and cloud infrastructure as code.

roles.title: Cloud Engineer
roles.description: Design, deploy and manage applications on AWS, Azure or GCP: compute, storage, networking and security.

roles.title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
roles.description: Own reliability of large production systems: monitoring, incident response, automation, capacity planning and Kubernetes.

roles.title: Android Developer
roles.description: Build native Android apps in Kotlin or Java with Android Studio, Jetpack and REST API integration.

roles.title: iOS Developer
roles.description: Build native iOS apps in Swift with SwiftUI or UIKit using Xcode.

roles.title: Cross-Platform Mobile Developer (Flutter / React Native)
roles.description: Build Android and iOS apps from a single codebase using Flutter with Dart or React Native with JavaScript.

roles.title: UI/UX Designer
roles.description: Research users, create wireframes and high-fidelity prototypes in Figma, and design intuitive interfaces and design systems.

roles.title: QA / Manual Test Engineer
roles.description: Write test plans and test cases, execute manual and API tests, and track bugs through the release cycle.

roles.title: QA Automation Engineer
roles.description: Build automated test suites with Selenium, Cypress or Playwright in Java or Python and run them in CI pipelines.

roles.title: Cybersecurity Analyst (SOC)
roles.description: Monitor security events with SIEM tools, analyse threats, respond to incidents and harden networks.

roles.title: Penetration Tester
roles.description: Perform vulnerability assessments and penetration tests on web apps and networks using Burp Suite, Metasploit and Kali Linux.

roles.title: Network Engineer
roles.description: Configure and troubleshoot routers, switches and firewalls; manage TCP/IP networks and VPNs.

roles.title: Database Administrator / SQL Developer
roles.description: Design schemas, write optimised SQL queries and stored procedures, and maintain relational databases.

roles.title: Embedded Systems Engineer
roles.description: Write firmware in Embedded C for microcontrollers, work with UART, SPI, I2C and real-time operating systems.

roles.title: IoT Developer
roles.description: Build connected devices with Arduino, ESP32 or Raspberry Pi, sensors, MQTT and cloud dashboards.

roles.title: Game Developer
roles.description: Build 2D and 3D games in Unity with C# or Unreal Engine with C++.

roles.title: Blockchain Developer
roles.description: Write and audit smart contracts in Solidity on Ethereum and build decentralised applications.

roles.title: Business Analyst
roles.description: Gather requirements, write user stories, map processes and analyse data with Excel and SQL to support decisions.

roles.title: Associate Product Manager
roles.description: Define product requirements, prioritise roadmaps, work with design and engineering in agile sprints, and use data to make decisions.

roles.title: Salesforce Developer
roles.description: Customise Salesforce CRM with Apex, Lightning components and workflows.

roles.title: Digital Marketing Analyst
roles.description: Run SEO and social media campaigns, track performance in Google Analytics and report results.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
roles.description: Lead design of scalable services, mentor engineers and own system architecture across a product area.

roles.title: Senior Data Scientist
roles.description: Lead end-to-end data science projects, set modelling strategy, mentor juniors and drive business impact with advanced machine learning.

roles.title: Engineering Manager / Tech Lead
roles.description: Manage an engineering team, own technical direction and delivery, hire and mentor engineers.
